observations.command:
set -eu
cat /proc/uptime
for bx_pair in 'boot:/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id' 'busnum:/sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/busnum' 'devnum:/sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/devnum' 'configuration:/sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/bConfigurationValue' 'authorized:/sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/authorized' 'runtimeStatus:/sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/power/runtime_status' 'interfaceNumber:/sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/bInterfaceNumber' 'alternate:/sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/bAlternateSetting' 'interfaceClass:/sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/bInterfaceClass' 'interfaceSubClass:/sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/bInterfaceSubClass' 'interfaceProtocol:/sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/bInterfaceProtocol'; do
 bx_name=${bx_pair%%:*}; bx_path=${bx_pair#*:}
 printf '%s=%s
' "$bx_name" "$(awk '{print $1}' "$bx_path")"
done
printf 'sysfsRealpath=%s
' "$(readlink -f /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1)"
printf 'sysfsStat=%s
' "$(stat -L -c '%d:%i' /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1)"
bx_devnum=$(cat /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/devnum)
bx_node=$(printf '/dev/bus/usb/007/%03d' "$bx_devnum")
printf 'deviceNode=%s
' "$bx_node"
printf 'nodeStat=%s
' "$(stat -L -c '%t:%T:%i' "$bx_node")"
printf 'descriptorsSha256=%s
' "$(sha256sum /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/descriptors | cut -d ' ' -f1)"
test ! -e /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/driver
test ! -L /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/driver
cat /proc/uptime

observations.command:
set -eu
cat /proc/uptime
bx_value=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
test "$bx_value" = 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
bx_value=$(readlink -f /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1)
test "$bx_value" = /sys/devices/platform/soc/2900000.drd/usb7/7-1
bx_value=$(stat -L -c "%d:%i" /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1)
test "$bx_value" = 19:40175
bx_value=$(cat /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/busnum)
test "$bx_value" = 7
bx_value=$(cat /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/devnum)
test "$bx_value" = 54
bx_value=$(printf %s /dev/bus/usb/007/054)
test "$bx_value" = /dev/bus/usb/007/054
bx_value=$(stat -L -c "%t:%T:%i" /dev/bus/usb/007/054)
test "$bx_value" = bd:335:12965889
bx_value=$(sha256sum /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/descriptors | cut -d " " -f1)
test "$bx_value" = 7293efb1f43f1166a3c54f193fe584a423d25beb41597b85f5d3452f211e0bc0
bx_value=$(cat /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/bConfigurationValue)
test "$bx_value" = 1
bx_value=$(cat /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/authorized)
test "$bx_value" = 1
bx_value=$(cat /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/power/runtime_status)
test "$bx_value" = active
bx_value=$(awk '{print $1}' /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/bInterfaceNumber)
test "$bx_value" = 02
bx_value=$(awk '{print $1}' /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/bAlternateSetting)
test "$bx_value" = 0
bx_value=$(awk '{print $1}' /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/bInterfaceClass)
test "$bx_value" = ff
bx_value=$(awk '{print $1}' /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/bInterfaceSubClass)
test "$bx_value" = 00
bx_value=$(awk '{print $1}' /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/bInterfaceProtocol)
test "$bx_value" = 00
test -c /dev/bus/usb/007/054
test ! -e /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/driver
test ! -L /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/driver
bx_pids=0
for bx_proc in /proc/[0-9]*; do
  test -d "$bx_proc" || continue
  bx_pids=$((bx_pids+1))
  test "$bx_pids" -le 4096
  test -d "$bx_proc/fd" || continue
  test -r "$bx_proc/fd" && test -x "$bx_proc/fd"
done
set -- /proc/[0-9]*/fd/*
test "$#" -ge 1
test "$#" -le 32768
if bx_fd_snapshot=$(LC_ALL=C stat -L -c "%F|%t:%T" "$@" 2>&1); then bx_stat_rc=0; else bx_stat_rc=$?; fi
printf '%s' "$bx_fd_snapshot" | awk -F '|' -v expected="$#" -v rc="$bx_stat_rc" -v bx_rdev=bd:335 'function missing_fd(line, prefix, rest, opener, suffix, path, fields, count) {
    prefix = "stat: cannot stat ";
    if (index(line, prefix) != 1) {
        prefix = "stat: cannot statx ";
        if (index(line, prefix) != 1) {
            prefix = "stat: can" apostrophe "t stat ";
            if (index(line, prefix) != 1) return 0;
        }
    }
    rest = substr(line, length(prefix) + 1);
    opener = substr(rest, 1, 1);
    if (opener != apostrophe && opener != backtick) return 0;
    suffix = apostrophe ": No such file or directory";
    if (length(rest) <= length(suffix) + 1 ||
        substr(rest, length(rest) - length(suffix) + 1) != suffix) return 0;
    path = substr(rest, 2, length(rest) - length(suffix) - 1);
    count = split(path, fields, "/");
    return count == 5 && fields[1] == "" && fields[2] == "proc" &&
           fields[3] ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && fields[4] == "fd" && fields[5] ~ /^[0-9]+$/;
}
BEGIN { missing=0; seen=0; holders=0; bad=0; apostrophe=sprintf("%c",39); backtick=sprintf("%c",96) }
missing_fd($0) { missing++; next }
NF == 2 { seen++; if ($1 == "character special file" && $2 == bx_rdev) holders++; next }
{ bad++ }
END { print "FDCENSUS expected=" expected " missing=" missing " holders=" holders " errors=" bad;
      if (bad || holders || seen + missing != expected || (rc == 0 && missing != 0) || rc > 1) exit 1 }'
bx_value=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
test "$bx_value" = 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
bx_value=$(readlink -f /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1)
test "$bx_value" = /sys/devices/platform/soc/2900000.drd/usb7/7-1
bx_value=$(stat -L -c "%d:%i" /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1)
test "$bx_value" = 19:40175
bx_value=$(cat /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/devnum)
test "$bx_value" = 54
bx_value=$(stat -L -c "%t:%T:%i" /dev/bus/usb/007/054)
test "$bx_value" = bd:335:12965889
bx_value=$(cat /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/power/runtime_status)
test "$bx_value" = active
bx_value=$(cat /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/bConfigurationValue)
test "$bx_value" = 1
test ! -e /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/driver
test ! -L /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/driver
echo QUALIFIED_METADATA
cat /proc/uptime
